dialogues.jp: にこにこ。
dialogues.en: Smile, smile.
dialogues.text: Smile, smile.

dialogues.jp: にこにこ。
dialogues.en: Smile, smile.
dialogues.text: Smile, smile.

dialogues.jp: 人の顔。
dialogues.en: A person's face.
dialogues.text: A person's face.

dialogues.jp: 笑顔が、ぽくっと浮かんでいる。
dialogues.en: A smile was etched onto it.
dialogues.text: A smile was etched onto it.

dialogues.jp:
真っ白な空間に、そこだけ、タバコの先端を押
しつけたように。
dialogues.en:
The entire place was white, the face like a cigarette being
pushed into it.
dialogues.text:
The entire place was white, the face like a cigarette being
pushed into it.

dialogues.jp:
あるいは、行楽地なんかに置いてある、顔の部
分だけ空白の板の人型。
dialogues.en:
A face in the middle of whiteness, it would be a tourist
attraction in the real world.
dialogues.text:
A face in the middle of whiteness, it would be a tourist
attraction in the real world.

dialogues.jp: にこにこ、にこにこ。笑顔だけが、そこに。
dialogues.en:
Smile smile, smile smile. In there, everything was about
smiling.
dialogues.text:
Smile smile, smile smile. In there, everything was about
smiling.

dialogues.en: "(...A dream.)"
dialogues.text: "(...A dream.)"

dialogues.jp:
浮かんでいる笑顔は、どうやら、子どもの頃の
ことりらしかった。
dialogues.en: The face holding the smile, was Kotori as a child, it seems.
dialogues.text: The face holding the smile, was Kotori as a child, it seems.

dialogues.jp:
それが、“どうやら”になってしまうのは、そ
の表情のせいだ。
dialogues.en:
The reason for the "it seems" was the expression of the
smile.
dialogues.text:
The reason for the "it seems" was the expression of the
smile.

dialogues.jp:
｛・・／仮面｝と見まがうような笑顔。今現在のことり
の、いきいきとしたそれとは、似ても似つか
ない……。
dialogues.en:
It was a smile that looked more like it was masking
something. It wasn't a smile that the Kotori of today would
give.
dialogues.text:
It was a smile that looked more like it was masking
something. It wasn't a smile that the Kotori of today would
give.

dialogues.jp: 本当に、ことり？
dialogues.en: Is this really Kotori?
dialogues.text: Is this really Kotori?

dialogues.jp:
にこにこ、にこにこ、少女は笑い続ける。ぽっ
かりと浮かび上がって。薄皮を張り付けたよう
に……。
dialogues.en:
Smile smile, smile smile. The girl contineud smiling. Then
another form materialized...
dialogues.text:
Smile smile, smile smile. The girl contineud smiling. Then
another form materialized...

dialogues.jp: 若い暦先生だ。
dialogues.en: A young Koyomi-sensei.
dialogues.text: A young Koyomi-sensei.

dialogues.jp: 「しわがありませんね、せんせ」
dialogues.en: "No wrinkles huh, sensei."
dialogues.text: "No wrinkles huh, sensei."

dialogues.jp:
バン──とは、出席簿は降ってこない。にこり
ともせず、眉もつり上げず、ただただ困惑して
いた。
dialogues.en:
There wasn't the usual "wham" of something hitting me on the
head. Instead, she was looking at the girl, her eyebrows
furrowed.
dialogues.text:
There wasn't the usual "wham" of something hitting me on the
head. Instead, she was looking at the girl, her eyebrows
furrowed.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「分からないなあ……」
dialogues.en: "I don't understand at all..."
dialogues.text: "I don't understand at all..."

dialogues.jp: ため息混じりの呟き。
dialogues.en: A sigh was mixed with her muttering.
dialogues.text: A sigh was mixed with her muttering.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「この子は、何を考えているのかしら？　分か
　らないなあ……」
dialogues.en: "What is this kid thinking? I really have no clue..."
dialogues.text: "What is this kid thinking? I really have no clue..."

dialogues.jp:
首を傾げながら、暦先生は去っていった。こと
りは、にこにこと笑い続ける。
dialogues.en:
Putting her head on her shoulder in thought, Koyomi-sensei
walked away. Kotori continued smiling away.
dialogues.text:
Putting her head on her shoulder in thought, Koyomi-sensei
walked away. Kotori continued smiling away.

dialogues.jp:
次にやって来たのは、壮年の男性と女性だった。
たぶん、ことりの──義理の？　──両親だ。
dialogues.en:
This time another two people came; two people in their 20s
or 30s. Seems like Kotori's -- assigned? -- parents.
dialogues.text:
This time another two people came; two people in their 20s
or 30s. Seems like Kotori's -- assigned? -- parents.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりとも、同じように腕を組んで、同じよう
に首を傾げる。
dialogues.en:
The two of them had their arms similarly crossed, and their
heads similarly inclined towards their sides in thought.
dialogues.text:
The two of them had their arms similarly crossed, and their
heads similarly inclined towards their sides in thought.

dialogues.jp: 呟く言葉は、これまた同じだった。
dialogues.en: The muttered words were the same as Koyomi's.
dialogues.text: The muttered words were the same as Koyomi's.

dialogues.jp: 分からないなあ。
dialogues.en: I don't understand.
dialogues.text: I don't understand.

dialogues.jp:
ふたりとも、立ち去っていく。暦先生のように、
首を傾げて。
dialogues.en:
The two of them took their leave, like Koyomi-sensei, with
their heads on their shoulder in thought.
dialogues.text:
The two of them took their leave, like Koyomi-sensei, with
their heads on their shoulder in thought.

dialogues.jp: （……分からない）
dialogues.en: "(...I don't understand.)"
dialogues.text: "(...I don't understand.)"

dialogues.jp:
分からないわからないワカラナイ──同じ事を、
ことりも言っていたじゃないか。
dialogues.en:
I don't understand, I don't understand, I-Don't-Understand--
weren't those the exact same words Kotori said before?"
dialogues.text:
I don't understand, I don't understand, I-Don't-Understand--
weren't those the exact same words Kotori said before?"

dialogues.jp:
立ち去った３人が、遠巻きにことりを眺めてい
る。顔を見合わせては、首を傾げるばかり。
dialogues.en:
The three who originally deperated the scene suddenly
reappeared, surrouding Kotori. They all exchanged glances,
deep in thought.
dialogues.text:
The three who originally deperated the scene suddenly
reappeared, surrouding Kotori. They all exchanged glances,
deep in thought.

dialogues.jp: 美味しかったら美味しいと。
dialogues.en: When you eat something good, you find it tasty.
dialogues.text: When you eat something good, you find it tasty.

dialogues.jp: 嬉しかったら嬉しいと。
dialogues.en: When something good happens, you feel happy.
dialogues.text: When something good happens, you feel happy.

dialogues.jp: 嫌だったら嫌だと。
dialogues.en: When something bad happens, you don't like it.
dialogues.text: When something bad happens, you don't like it.

dialogues.jp: 正直な心の中を……。
dialogues.en: That's the honesty of the heart...
dialogues.text: That's the honesty of the heart...

dialogues.jp: 泣きたかったら泣いて。
dialogues.en: When you feel like crying, you cry.
dialogues.text: When you feel like crying, you cry.

dialogues.jp: 怒りたかったら怒って。
dialogues.en: When you feel angry, you get angry.
dialogues.text: When you feel angry, you get angry.

dialogues.jp: 笑いたい時にこそ笑う。
dialogues.en: When you feel like lauging, you laugh.
dialogues.text: When you feel like lauging, you laugh.

dialogues.jp:
ありのままのことりを見せて欲しい３人は、張
り付いた笑顔に戸惑いを隠せないようだった。
dialogues.en:
The three people looking at Kotori simplyNcouldn't tell what
she was feeling, as a smile was seemingly plastered on her
face.
dialogues.text:
The three people looking at Kotori simplyNcouldn't tell what
she was feeling, as a smile was seemingly plastered on her
face.

dialogues.jp: （……一体これは、誰の夢なんだろう？）
dialogues.en: "(...Just whose dream is this?)"
dialogues.text: "(...Just whose dream is this?)"

dialogues.jp:
４人それぞれの心中が正しく反映されているら
しい、この夢は。
dialogues.en: It has to be one of the 4 here...
dialogues.text: It has to be one of the 4 here...

dialogues.jp: 不意に、笑顔が消える。
dialogues.en: Then suddenly, the smile disappeared.
dialogues.text: Then suddenly, the smile disappeared.

dialogues.jp: プルルルル……。
dialogues.en: *ring ring*...
dialogues.text: *ring ring*...

dialogues.jp: ｛かたず／固唾｝を呑んで、息を詰めていることり。
dialogues.en: Kotori was lightly holding her breath, looking worried.
dialogues.text: Kotori was lightly holding her breath, looking worried.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「ことり、電話よ……知子ちゃんって子から」
dialogues.en: "Kotori, it's for you... it's a kid called Tomoko-chan."
dialogues.text: "Kotori, it's for you... it's a kid called Tomoko-chan."

dialogues.jp:
ぱっと弾けるような笑顔を浮かべ──それは、
まさしくことりのものだ──電話へと走ってい
く。
dialogues.en:
In a flash, the smile exploded onto Kotori's face again -- a
smile far more like Kotori -- as she walked towards the
phone.
dialogues.text:
In a flash, the smile exploded onto Kotori's face again -- a
smile far more like Kotori -- as she walked towards the
phone.

dialogues.jp:
その小さな背中を見つめながら、暦先生は小さ
くため息をついた。
dialogues.en:
As she watched the small back totter it's way to the phone,
Koyomi-sensei let out a small sigh.
dialogues.text:
As she watched the small back totter it's way to the phone,
Koyomi-sensei let out a small sigh.

dialogues.jp: ◆にこにこ◆
dialogues.en: ◆Smile smile◆
dialogues.text: ◆Smile smile◆

dialogues.jp: 夢を見ている。
dialogues.en: I saw a dream.
dialogues.text: I saw a dream.

dialogues.jp:
にこにこと、笑う人の顔が、ぽっくりと浮かん
でいる夢。
dialogues.en: A dream where a person's smiling face was the main subject.
dialogues.text: A dream where a person's smiling face was the main subject.

dialogues.jp:
それは、幼いことりの表情だ。ことりの家族も
登場する。
dialogues.en:
That person was Kotori as a child. Kotori's family was
present as well.
dialogues.text:
That person was Kotori as a child. Kotori's family was
present as well.

dialogues.jp:
分からない……。表情から、心の内は、何も窺
えないのだった。
dialogues.en:
No one understood... her expression, what she really felt,
no one could tell.
dialogues.text:
No one understood... her expression, what she really felt,
no one could tell.
